pageHead.title: Partnership
pageHead.desc: Bring Dawn Errand to your city and build the local on-demand delivery ecosystem together.

modes.title: Partnership Models
modes.desc: Four ways to partner, for city partners, merchants, riders and channel partners.

items.title: City Partner
items.desc: Own regional market operations and growth; the platform provides system, operations and support to serve the local errand / food-delivery market together.

items.title: Merchant Onboarding
items.desc: Restaurants, retailers and convenience stores onboard and open stores, gaining online orders and store management to grow local business.

items.title: Rider Recruitment
items.desc: Part-time / full-time riders join to accept orders, with per-order settlement and transparent income; the platform provides delivery tools and support.

items.title: Channel Partnership
items.desc: System integrators, SaaS channel partners and industry solution providers bring platform capabilities to more local markets.

steps.title: How It Works
steps.desc: Four steps to partnership — simple and transparent.

items.title: Submit Intent
items.desc: Submit your partnership intent and target region via the form below or contact channels.

items.title: Solution Discussion
items.desc: Our business team discusses regional context, partnership model and operating plan with you.

items.title: Sign & Deploy
items.desc: Confirm the details, sign the agreement, and the platform deploys and initializes the regional hub.

items.title: Launch Operations
items.desc: Merchant onboarding, rider recruitment and market promotion — local operations go live.
